live.title: Live trackers
live.description: Read from the native tracker status. “~” marks a calibrated estimate; hover for how it was measured.

live.noPreset: Create a preset with skills to track below. Cooldowns need an explicit catalogue duration or a calibrated in-game timer; buffs are tracked on your own character.
